description: Write a full report from tabular data as a PDF plus an editable Word file (.docx) and PowerPoint deck (.pptx): KPI tiles, the top findings, a written summary and charts. chartType 'gantt' makes a project report (plan review, critical path, status, workload); every other chart type makes a data report (trends, breakdowns, data quality, relationships, ...). Requires a CleanChart API key (Authorization: Bearer cc_...) on Pro or an active Deadline Pass — otherwise it returns payment_required; only call create_checkout if the user asks to buy. Takes up to a minute. The files come back as download links valid for 24 hours (CleanChart stores the finished files for that time, never the data): always show every link to the user. Limits: 5 reports per dataset, 20 per account per day. Data reports need 10 to 20,000 rows; project reports need at least 5 tasks with calendar dates and at most 2,000 rows. Call validate_chart_config first.

chartType.description: Chart type id from list_chart_types: 'gantt' makes a project report, any other type a data report

config.description: Validated chart config, the same one generate_chart takes

data.description: Tabular data as an array of row objects, e.g. [{"Month":"2026-01","Sales":120}, ...]. All rows should share the same keys (column names).

language.description: Data reports only: the language to write the report in. Default: detected from the column names. Project reports are always English.

title.description: Report title for page 1 and the file names, e.g. the name of the user's data file

today.description: The user's local date as YYYY-MM-DD; project reports measure task status against it. Default: the server's date.

name: generate_report
title: Generate report
